contract: Null callback returns ffffffff and leaves old slot untouched; any nonzero full-word callback is stored exactly and returns0. Single existing volatile slot reused; no new state.
assembly_removed: Fixed r0/r1/r2/r3 bindings and empty constraints removed. Existing C port initializer ignores return, reads no scratch registers. Standard C ABI does not promise caller-saved register values.
limits: Stock read and replay establish bounded registration behavior, not callback validity, radio delivery or final boot.

Every16 native instruction bytes execute; source execution into stock code is rejected. Slot guards, return, callee-saved registers, SP and interrupt masks checked. Incidental caller-saved values/private stack layout excluded.
Flash read/write bindings are retained because partial-read consumers can observe stale stack bytes; their coupled ownership must be resolved before removal.
852 translation units compile/compose;66 application and22 bootloader imports remain.
